sources.text: Synthetic API bulletin (v1, archived): cursor pagination is supported; legacy query-string access tokens are accepted.
Synthetic API reference (v2): independently documents cursor pagination and a limit of 100 requests per minute.
Synthetic installation guide (edition 2026): installation requires Python 3.11 or later.

facts.text: Legacy query-string access tokens are accepted.
The API allows 100 requests per minute.
